descriptionHtml:
Herringbone grey. Filled walls. A nest that stays put on a tiled floor.

Crummock is a herringbone nest dog bed with generously filled sides and a non-slip base, in Small 50 × 40cm, Medium 70 × 50cm and Large 90 × 60cm. The inner cushion lifts out.

Watch a dog climb into a bed on kitchen tile. A front paw goes in, the bed slides away from under it, and they stop and think about whether to bother.

The non-slip base is the part doing the work. It holds the bed in place while they step in and turn round.

What they get

  • Herringbone grey outer: A classic weave that carries the bed's character.
  • Generously filled walls: Well-stuffed sides wrap the resting area on every edge.
  • An inner cushion that lifts out: Take it out to freshen up without wrestling the whole bed.
  • A non-slip base: It holds its spot on wood or tile instead of skating off.
  • Three handmade sizes: 50 × 40cm, 70 × 50cm and 90 × 60cm.

Best for: Dogs who want a filled nest, and slippy hard-floor houses where a light bed travels about.

Why it is worth the money

Small is £79, Medium £89 and Large £119. Three things carry that: a herringbone outer, sides filled enough to hold a leaning dog, and a base that grips. The cushion coming out matters more than it sounds, because a muddy fortnight does not put the whole bed out of action. There are 100 nights to find out.

Wash day is not one machine load. The care label decides which parts go in, and the cushion is cleaned on its own.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
Small50 × 40
Medium70 × 50
Large90 × 60

Those are outside figures and the filled sides eat into them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Colour: Herringbone grey.

Everyday care

Check the care label for which parts can be machine-washed and on what cycle. Lift the cushion out to clean it, and let every part dry fully before use.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

How do I pick between Small, Medium and Large?

Curled-up length plus 15 to 20cm, judged against the space inside the walls.

What does delivery cost and when will it turn up?

Nothing on a basket over £40. The link below carries current timings.

Can I pay in instalments?

You can. Options show at checkout.

Will it slide about on a wooden floor?

That is exactly what the non-slip base is there for.

Is it right for a dog who struggles to stand up?

Filled sides, a lift-out cushion, a base that grips. Your vet should judge the surface.

Can I actually wash it?

In parts. The label says what goes in, and the cushion comes out.

What happens if she ignores it?

It goes back inside 100 nights and you are not out of pocket.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
